name: Dashboard shows hardcoded zeros and empty activity feed

steps_to_reproduce: Log in to the CS-ERP application
Observe all 4 stats cards show value=0 with 'Coming soon'
Observe activity feed shows 'No recent activity' always
Quick action links go to correct hub pages but dashboard gives no operational overview
content.expected_behavior: Dashboard should show real-time counts from the database: active vessels from mdm_vessels, open bookings from csp_portal_bookings, containers in transit from csp_shipment_tracking, pending customs from ccr_import_clearances. Activity feed should show recent records created across these tables.
content.actual_behavior: All 4 stats cards are hardcoded to value={0} with description='Coming soon'. No DB queries are executed. Activity feed component receives no items prop, always shows empty state.
content.root_cause_analysis: Dashboard page (src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx) was built as a placeholder shell. Stats cards pass literal value={0} instead of queried counts. ActivityFeed is rendered without items prop. No server-side DB queries exist in the page component.
content.fix_approach: Add server-side DB count queries in the async page component using Drizzle ORM. Query 4 tables with tenant isolation (session.tenantId). Pass real counts to StatsCard components. Query recent records across tables for ActivityFeed items. Use Promise.all() for parallel fetching.
content.description: The main dashboard page at / shows hardcoded zeros for all 4 stats cards and an always-empty activity feed. The page needs server-side Drizzle queries to count active vessels, open bookings, containers in transit, and pending customs clearances. It also needs to fetch recent activity items from these tables.
acceptance_criteria: Active Vessels stat shows COUNT of mdm_vessels WHERE status='active' AND tenant_id=session.tenantId AND deleted_at IS NULL
Open Bookings stat shows COUNT of csp_portal_bookings WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled','completed') AND tenant_id=session.tenantId AND deleted_at IS NULL
Containers in Transit stat shows COUNT of csp_shipment_tracking WHERE current_status='in_transit' AND tenant_id=session.tenantId AND deleted_at IS NULL
Pending Customs stat shows COUNT of ccr_import_clearances WHERE status IN ('draft','pending','filed') AND tenant_id=session.tenantId AND deleted_at IS NULL
Description text on each card shows contextual info (e.g. '+2 this week') or module name instead of 'Coming soon'
Activity feed shows up to 10 most recent records across the 4 tables, ordered by created_at DESC
Each activity item shows a human-readable message (e.g. 'Booking BK-2026-001 created') and relative timestamp
All queries use tenant isolation via session.tenantId
All queries use Promise.all() for parallel fetching
Dashboard loads within 2 seconds (no N+1 queries)
edge_cases: New tenant with zero records in all tables — all stats show 0, activity feed shows empty state (existing behavior preserved)
Table has only soft-deleted records — stats show 0 (filtered by deleted_at IS NULL)
Very large table (10000+ rows) — COUNT queries use indexed status column, still fast
Session expired mid-render — redirect to /login (existing auth check handles this)
Activity feed items from different tables have different timestamp formats — normalize to relative time strings
error_handling: Any individual count query fails — show 0 for that stat, don't crash entire dashboard (use try/catch per query or fallback in Promise.allSettled)
Activity feed query fails — show empty state with 'No recent activity' (existing fallback)
DB connection pool exhausted — Next.js error boundary shows error page
security_considerations: All queries MUST filter by tenant_id — no cross-tenant data leakage
No raw SQL — use Drizzle ORM parameterized queries only
Auth check already exists on line 9-10 (getSession + redirect)
content.implementation_notes: Pattern: import db and schema tables, query in async page component after auth check, pass results to existing components. Drizzle exports: vessels (mdm_vessels), cspPortalBookings (csp_portal_bookings), cspShipmentTracking (csp_shipment_tracking), ccrImportClearances (ccr_import_clearances). All from '@/db/schema'. Use sql`count(*)` or db.select({ count: count() }).from(table).where(). For activity feed, UNION is complex — simpler to do 4 separate queries (limit 3 each) and merge+sort in JS.
testing_requirements: Stats show real counts matching DB state
Activity feed shows recent items ordered by time
Page works correctly for tenant with no data (all zeros, empty feed)
